About Jasper

The man, the mission, the vision.

PORTRAIT PHOTO

His Story

Jasper Gachunga is a renowned businessman in Kenya, with ventures that directly and indirectly feed over 20,000 households.

He has also served as a Board Member of KenInvest, adding experience in public institutions to his career in business.

Through the Jasper Gachunga Foundation, which he runs, he gives back to the community and helps the needy in society, especially here in Roysambu.

BusinessmanCommunity builderGolf enthusiastA leader who listens

My Agenda

Maendeleo kwa Wote: development for all.

Our Vision

A united, peaceful, inclusive, and prosperous Roysambu.

Where every resident has the opportunity to succeed.

“Committed to Accelerated Development, Integrity and Dedicated Service to Our People.”

Key Focus Areas

EducationQuality schools, skills and a brighter future
DevelopmentBetter infrastructure and opportunities
People EmpowermentYouth, women and community driven growth
IntegrityTransparent and accountable leadership
Quality ServicesImproved education, healthcare and a safer Roysambu

Our Four Pillars

Pillar 1

Values and Integrity

We will lead with honesty, accountability, and accessibility, guided by fairness, respect, transparency, and service to the people.

Pillar 2

Economic Empowerment

We will back small businesses, traders, professionals, service providers, youth, and women-led enterprises, and promote innovation, technology, and job creation. We will push for affordable credit, skills training, organised trading spaces, and a business-friendly Roysambu.

Pillar 3

Social Development

We will bring residents together across communities, generations, and backgrounds. We will promote better education, healthcare, clean water, sanitation, security, and opportunities for youth, while increasing women’s participation and supporting vulnerable residents.

Pillar 4

Urban Development

We will deliver better roads, drainage, water, sanitation, waste management, street lighting, and public safety. We will also work for health facilities, modern markets, efficient transport, pedestrian facilities, parks, and youth centres.

Our Leadership Style

ElephantTeamwork and consultation.
BuffaloProtecting residents’ interests and dignity.
GiraffeA long-term vision for a modern Roysambu.
MonkeyListening, negotiation, and practical compromise.

Roysambu

Our home, our future.

History of Roysambu

Roysambu is one of the 17 constituencies in Nairobi City County, located in the northern part of Nairobi. It covers approximately 48.8 square kilometres and borders areas including Kasarani, Ruaraka, Ruiru and Westlands.
